programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem

programme.title: అమెరికాస్ వైల్డ్ సీజన్స్

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate the superpredators that ruled the seas. Global expeditions yield new evidence of the strangest sharks to ever roam the ocean, and groundbreaking CGI technology brings them back to life.

programme.title: డెసర్ట్ డైనోసార్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.sub-title: An early fish journeys to the ends of the ocean to find a mate before his exotic and colourful reef is destroyed by freezing waters
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: లోవెన్ గెగెన్ హైయనెన్
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాలు, హైనాల ప్రవర్తనను పరిశీలించి, వాటి శత్రుత్వానికి ప్రేరేపించిన ఆలోచనలను సవాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జ్యూయెల్స్ ఆఫ్ ద న్యాచురల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత జంతువుల భీకర స్వభావం, సంరక్షణ గురించి వివరిస్తూ, ప్రపంచంలోని పలు ప్రాంతాల వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఇంటు ది వైల్డ్: ఇండియా
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు భారతదేశ అపరిమితమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అంతర్దృష్టిని అందించారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: రివర్ మాన్స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill
programme.desc: జీవశాస్త్రవేత్త జెరెమీ వేడ్ పురాణాలు, స్వచ్ఛమైననీటి రహస్యాలు, జానపద కథలను అన్వేషించడానికి బయలుదేరాడు.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: ఇంటు ది వైల్డ్: ఇండియా
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు భారతదేశ అపరిమితమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అంతర్దృష్టిని అందించారు.

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: There are many stoic creatures that survive in the unforgiving sands of arid deserts like elephants, the Namaqua chameleon and the shovel-snouted lizard
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: The end of November marks the finish of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to lush wetland
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Wild predators employ a variety of predatory techniques. However, wolves rely upon an excellent sense of smell whilst cats confront stamina issues
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: క్యూట్ టు కిల్లర్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker chronicles the journey of four cubs in Zimbabwe, home to Africa's top predators, as they grow from two weeks to three-year-old hunters, evolving from 'cute to killer'
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికాలోని మాంసాహారులకు నిలయమైన జింబాబ్వేలో రెండు వారాల నుండి మూడేళ్ళ వేటగాళ్లుగా ఎదిగిన నాలుగు పిల్లలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the not so well known story, the true nature and life of a seriously misunderstood and neglected mammal on earth, a giant hippo bull
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share the buffalo with the rest of the pride while Fig continues to give lessons to the young cub
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the attack instinct displayed by apex predators of the wild and provides insights into their deadly behaviour
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: వండ్రస్ అండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: The lives of different species from around the world are showcased to highlight their survival patterns, challenges and moments of joy
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అడవిలో అనుభవజ్ఞులైన వివిధ రకాల జంతువులు, వాటి చిన్న సంతానం అడవిలో ఎలా మనుగడ సాగిస్తాయో చూపుతారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: While rivers are the womb of a place, it is ruled by dangerous creatures like hippos, crocodiles, water monitors and fish eagles who battle relentlessly to establish supremacy
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఆన్ ద ట్రయల్ ఆఫ్ స్నో లెపర్డ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మంచు చిరుతపులి కోసం అన్వేషిస్తూ, ఈ జంతువులు తిరిగే అరుదైన దృశ్యాన్ని చూసే నిపుణుల అనుభవాలను రికార్డు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: As the dry season takes hold in Luangwa Valley, lagoons evaporate and verdant grasslands gradually turn to dust. Furthermore, animals must take advantage while they can
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Felines and canids go head-to-head, engaging in direct battles, as well as strategies to steal food. Moreover, intelligence and strength decide who rules in each territory
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: వండ్రస్ అండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: The lives of different species from around the world are showcased to highlight their survival patterns, challenges and moments of joy
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అడవిలో అనుభవజ్ఞులైన వివిధ రకాల జంతువులు, వాటి చిన్న సంతానం అడవిలో ఎలా మనుగడ సాగిస్తాయో చూపుతారు.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఆన్ ది రన్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows a young male tiger's journey from helpless cub to confident adult as it survives alone in the wild after being forced from its territory
programme.desc: తన భూభాగం నుండి బయటికి వెళ్ళిపోయినా చిన్న మగ పులి కుమాల్, అడవిలో జీవిస్తూ, ఎలా పెరిగి, పెద్దదయ్యిందో చూడండి.

programme.title: ది లెపర్డ్ రాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In a remote, secluded region of Rajasthan, leopards thrive and exhibit astonishing behaviour. One particular leopard mother, Neelam, does her best to protect her three cubs from wandering adult males
programme.desc: రాజస్థాన్‌లోని ఒకమారుమూల ప్రాంతంలో నీలం అనే తల్లి చిరుతపులి తన పిల్లలను రక్షించుకోవడానికి తన శాయశక్తులా ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: Killers of the wild are so lethal and dangerous that it merely requires an expression from them to make the jungle quiver and flee in fear
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: ది బ్రదర్స్ ప్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker dives into the behaviour of lions in the wild, shedding light on their hunting techniques, territorial disputes and complex relationships
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అడవిలో సింహాల ప్రవర్తన, వాటి వేట పద్ధతులు, ప్రాదేశిక వివాదాలు మరియు సంక్లిష్ట సంబంధాలపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Numerous animals adapt through a series of small mutations in order to compete more effectively in the game of evolution
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద కిల్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker shines a light on a pride of lionesses living on the banks of a river in Tanzania, highlighting their struggle to survive amidst scarcity of water and prey
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు టాంజానియాలోని ఒక నది ఒడ్డున నివసించే ఆడసింహాల గర్వం గురించి, మనుగడ కోసం అవి చేసే పోరాటం గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's most deadly snakes in order to educate and inspire people to see the value of these misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share the buffalo with the rest of the pride while Fig continues to give lessons to the young cub
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Namibie sauvage
programme.desc: Exploring the natural wonders of Namibia, a country of contrasts in southern Africa that is home to diverse flora and fauna throughout its arid savannahs, flowing rivers, and rugged coastlines.

programme.title: ఇన్వేషన్ ఆఫ్ మెగా షార్క్స్
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

programme.title: లయన్ క్వీన్స్: ఫైటింగ్ ఫర్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: A group of lionesses faces growing challenges as changing landscapes and rival predators threaten their survival, pushing them to adapt in new and unexpected ways

programme.title: ద కిల్

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share the buffalo with the rest of the pride while Fig continues to give lessons to the young cub
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Namibie sauvage
programme.desc: Exploring the natural wonders of Namibia, a country of contrasts in southern Africa that is home to diverse flora and fauna throughout its arid savannahs, flowing rivers, and rugged coastlines.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: As the dry season takes hold in Luangwa Valley, lagoons evaporate and verdant grasslands gradually turn to dust. Furthermore, animals must take advantage while they can
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Felines and canids go head-to-head, engaging in direct battles, as well as strategies to steal food. Moreover, intelligence and strength decide who rules in each territory
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into lionesses and hyenas nursing their young and teaching them how to adapt to the wild

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: During a spring season on the Gomoti River, mothers take charge as they train their young ones essential survival skills to thrive in the wild
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the history and architecture of the monuments and buildings in Saint Petersburg, the second-largest city in Russia

programme.title: అమెరికాస్ వైల్డ్ సీజన్స్
programme.sub-title: Nature awakens from its slumber during spring in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests
programme.desc: ప్రతి సీజన్ లో పర్యావరణంలో వచ్చే అద్భుతమైన పరివర్తనల గురించి తెలుపుతూ, అమెరికాలోని విభిన్న ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate early predators that ruled the seas; global expeditions yield new evidence of sharks that once roamed the ocean, and CGI technology brings them back to life.

programme.title: लज्जा
programme.sub-title: Trapped within the confines of a male-dominated society, four courageous women fight their battles, each unrelated yet resonant with the others
programme.desc: पुरुष प्रधान समाज की शिकार चार अलग-अलग महिलाओं को हालात एक-दूसरे से मिलाते हैं। लेकिन वे अपने ऊपर होने वाले अत्याचारों का विरोध करती हैं और अपने अधिकारों के लिए लड़ती हैं।.

credits.actor: Manisha Koirala,Madhuri Dixit,Rekha,Mahima Chaudhry,Ajay Devgan,Anil Kapoor,Jackie Shroff,Danny Denzongpa,Gulshan Grover,Aarti Chhabria,Sharman Joshi,Sonali Bendre

programme.title: बाल हनुमान रिटर्न ऑफ द डेमोन
programme.sub-title: Bal Hanuman and his friends join together to defeat the crocodile demon who has been brought to life in order to create havoc on Earth
programme.desc: बाल हनुमान और उनके मित्र मिलकर मगरमच्छ राक्षस को पराजित करते हैं, जिसे पृथ्वी पर उत्पात मचाने के लिए जीवित किया गया है।.

credits.actor: Ashar Shaikh (Bal Hanuman),Shanoor Mirza (Rocket),Anshul Chandra (Locket),Sandeep Karnik (Gurudev),Shailendra Pandey

programme.title: चल मेरे भाई
programme.sub-title: Destiny entangles Sapna with a bereaved Vicky and his fun-loving younger brother Prem Oberoi in a tapestry of romance, heartbreak, and sacrifice
programme.desc: एक व्यापारी, विकी, अपने छोटे भाई प्रेम से प्यार करता है, जो लड़कियों को लुभाने की कोशिश करता रहता है। परिवार को लगता है कि सचिव, सपना विकी के लिए एक अच्छी पत्नी होगी पर वो प्रेम से प्यार करती है।.

credits.actor: Sanjay Dutt (Vicky Oberoi),Salman Khan (Prem Oberoi),Karisma Kapoor (Sapna Mehra),Dalip Tahil (Balraj Oberoi),Sushma Seth (Grandmother (Dadima)),Shakti Kapoor (Sapna's uncle (Mamaji)),Himani Shivpuri (Sapna's aunt (Mamiji)),Shahbaz Khan (Rakesh),Javed Khan (Murari),Shashi Kiran (Suri),Sonali Bendre (Piya),Nagma (Sonia)

programme.title: फिलर
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: मन
programme.sub-title: Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to their respective partners and decide to reunite after six months to get married. However, destiny has other plans for them
programme.desc: देव और प्रिया की सगाई हो चुकी है, फिर भी उन्हें एक-देसरे से प्यार हो जाता है और वे शादी करने के लिए छह महीने बाद फिर से मिलने का फैसला करते हैं। हालाँकि, उनकी नियति में कुछ और लिखा है।.

credits.actor: Aamir Khan,Manisha Koirala,Sharmila Tagore,Neeraj Vora,Anil Kapoor,Dipti Bhatnagar,Dalip Tahil,Shama Sikander

programme.title: हमराज़
programme.sub-title: A wealthy Raj Singhania begins an affair with Priya, an entertainer who already has a boyfriend. While they start their relationship, Priya's lover decides to get his revenge on them
programme.desc: करण और प्रिया, कारोबारी राज की संपत्ति हड़पने के लिए प्रिया की शादी उससे करवाने की योजना बनाते हैं। लेकिन प्रिया, करण को छोड़ देती है और करण बदला लेने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Bobby Deol,Akshaye Khanna,Amisha Patel,Johnny Lever,Suhasini Mulay,Firoz Irani,Dilip Joshi

programme.title: भूतनाथ
programme.sub-title: When a mischievous ghost returns to his ancestral home, chaos unfolds with both humor and heart as he tries to protect his family and teach valuable lessons to the living
programme.desc: एक शरारती भूत अपने पैतृक घर में लौटता है, तो हास्य और हृदय दोनों के साथ अराजकता फैलती है, क्योंकि वह अपने परिवार की रक्षा करने और जीवित लोगों को मूल्यवान सबक सिखाने की कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan,Shahrukh Khan,Juhi Chawla,Aman Siddiqui,Satish Shah,Neena Kulkarni

programme.title: अँखियों से गोली मारे
programme.sub-title: Bhandari Dada wants his daughter, Kiran, to get married to a gangster. Kiran, however, falls in love with Raj, a wealthy man, and convinces him to pose as a gangster to impress her father
programme.desc: भंगारी दादा अपनी बेटी किरण की शादी एक गैंगस्टर से करवाना चाहते हैं। लेकिन किरण, एक अमीर आदमी राज से प्यार करने लगती है और अपने पिता को प्रभावित करने के लिए उसे गैंगस्टर बनने के लिए मना लेती है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Raveena Tandon,Kader Khan,Shakti Kapoor,Johny Lever,Asrani,Anjana Mumtaz,Satyen Kappu,Avtar Gill,Dinesh Hingoo

programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
programme.sub-title: Handy-Verbot / Stein kann nicht schlafen
programme.desc: Papier ist frustriert darüber, dass Stein und Schere ständig auf ihre Handys starren, also nimmt er ihnen diese weg, um einen Tag echter gemeinsamer Zeit zu erzwingen. Anfangs sind sie widerwillig, aber bald genießen sie das alte, analoge Miteinander. Papier ist begeistert - bis er entdeckt, dass währenddessen eine Zombie-Apokalypse ausgebrochen ist. Schlimmer noch: Wenn Stein und Schere davon erfahren, könnte ihre Freundschaft zerstört werden. // Stein beschwert sich, dass er nicht schlafen kann, also versuchen Papier und Schere, ihm eine Gute-Nacht-Geschichte zu erzählen. Doch alle drei haben völlig unterschiedliche Vorstellungen davon, was eine gute Geschichte ist - Papier verliert sich in Details, Schere übertreibt mit wilden Wendungen, und Stein ist ein harter Kritiker. Wie bei Goldlöckchen müssen sie eine Geschichte finden, die genau richtig ist.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
programme.sub-title: Schere ist ein ganz Lieber / Papiers Familientreffen
programme.desc: Stein will seinem Boss Franz Roll näherkommen und lädt ihn ein. Doch als Franz ankommt und Schere zum ersten Mal sieht, hält er ihn für einen Hund. Schere spielt die Illusion mit, da er in Franz' Villa ein komfortables Leben erwartet, wenn dieser ihn adoptiert. Franz und Schere kommen sich näher, was Stein frustriert, während er versucht, Franz zur Vernunft zu bringen. Papier wiederum versucht verzweifelt zu beweisen, dass er nicht langweilig ist. // Papier fürchtet das jährliche Familientreffen, da seine Familie extrem erfolgreich ist: seine Schwester Sandpapier ist Actionstar, sein Vater Backpapier ein berühmter Koch, seine Mutter Zeitungspapier eine bekannte Journalistin und sein Bruder Toilettenpapier ein weltberühmter Comedian. Um sich nicht erneut zu blamieren, plant Papier, sich selbst entführen zu lassen.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Autoschalter / Heiße Reifen
programme.desc: Ein kleiner baulicher Mangel und ein fortschrittlicher Kunde lassen Mr. Krabs das Serviceangebot der Krossen Krabbe um einen Autoschalter erweitern. Dies erweist sich in mehrfacher Hinsicht als durchschlagender Erfolg, da Mr. Krabs aufgrund des großen Andrangs per Vorschlaghammer Schalter um Schalter eröffnet, bis nicht nur sein Personal, sondern auch das örtliche Straßennetz völlig überlastet ist... // Tony Junior, Sohn der Rennfahrerlegende Tony Flott wird in Mrs. Puffs Bootsfahrschule eingeschult. Tatsächlich hat der Junge das Talent seines Vaters geerbt, und tatsächlich scheint Mrs. Puffs Plan aufzugehen, dass ein wenig dessen auf den bislang unbelehrbaren SpongeBob abfärben möge - denn Tony Juniors Mantra "Lass los, sei cool" zeigt Wirkung. Bald sitzt SpongeBob sogar am Steuer eines Rennbootes! Leider ist das erwartungsgemäß der Anfang vom Ende..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Sportsfeinde
programme.desc: Aufgrund schlechten Wetters verwandeln SpongeBob und Patrick das Schwammkopfsche Wohnzimmer in eine Minigolfanlage. Leider verlagert sich das Spielgeschehen irgendwann hinüber zu Nachbar Thaddäus, dessen Einrichtung unter wuchtigen Schlägen schwer zu leiden hat - und nicht nur die... // Patrick schimpft mit SpongeBob, weil der im Zuge des Frühjahrsputzes auch einige Andenken dem Müll überantwortet hat. Das nimmt sich unser Schwamm zu Herzen und hortet nun jede Kleinigkeit mit potentiellem Erinnerungswert - bis der Müll überhand nimmt und Thaddäus sich gezwungen sieht, die Gesundheitspolizei zu rufen..

programme.sub-title: Eis für Ke$ha

programme.title: Victorious 3
programme.sub-title: Fragestunde mit Pärchen
programme.desc: Toris Pear Phone ist im Eimer, aber sie will sich kein neues GX holen, weil angeblich das neue XT rauskommen soll. Also behilft sie sich mit diversen Provisorien. Als sie sich am Ende doch ein neues GX kauft, passiert das, was sie befürchtet hatte. Am nächsten Morgen kommt das Pear Phone XT raus und sie steht mit ihrem alten GX doof da. Sinjin hat eine Spiel-Show entwickelt, in der er Pärchen Fragen stellt, um heraus zu bekommen, wie gut sie zusammen passen. In Ermangelung showtauglicher echter Pärchen treten neben Beck und Jade, Tori und Robbie an, sowie Andre und Cat. Die Show wird ein Desaster. Und am Ende werden Beck und Jade auch noch zum "schlimmsten Paar" der Show gewählt. Die Beiden hören überhaupt nicht mehr auf, sich zu streiten. Da stellt Jade Beck ein Ultimatum. Sie zählt bis zehn, wenn er dann nicht zu ihr gekommen ist, macht sie Schluss. Und tatsächlich trennen sich die Beiden.

programme.title: Victorious 3
programme.sub-title: Eine schrecklich fiese Freundin
programme.desc: Andre ist mit Hope zusammen. Er mag sie zwar nicht, aber ihr Vater ist ein berühmter Musikproduzent.Jetzt soll Andres auf Hopes Geburtstagsfeier singen, wo auch Hopes Vater anwesend ist. Aber nachdem er mit Tori geredet hat, besinnt er sich eines Besseren und will Hope die Wahrheit sagen und noch vor dem Auftritt mit ihr Schluss machen. Sie akzeptiert das aber nicht und besteht darauf, dass er seinen Geburtstagssong auf ihrer Feier singt.Gleichzeitig passen Cat und Jade auf den Hund vom Chef von Cats Mom, Mr. Gibbons, auf. Dabei stellt sich heraus, dass dieser Mann unglaublich teure Sachen/Antiquitäten in seinem Haus hat. Jade wirft aus Versehen eine Originalgitarre von Elvis Presley zu Boden und später geht noch ein echter menschlicher Schädel kaputt.Mit Hilfe von Beck und Robbie versuchen sie, den Schaden zu reparieren, schaffen es aber bis zur Rückkehr von Mr. Gibbons nicht. Aber kurz bevor er sein Haus betritt und den Schaden sieht, ereignet sich ein Erdbeben und diverse Sachen gehen zu Bruch. So fällt es nicht auf, dass die Gitarre und der Schädel schon vorher kaputt waren.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.sub-title: Eine Nacht bei Sikowitz
programme.desc: Eigentlich lebt Tori Vega das Leben eines ganz normalen Teenagers - bis ihr das Schicksal einen völlig neuen Weg eröffnet: Toris Schwester ist krank und kann deswegen nicht an der anstehenden Talentshow der renommierten Hollywood Arts High School teilnehmen. programme.title: Victorious 3
programme.sub-title: Der Gorilla Club
programme.desc: Tori hat ein Vorsprechen für einen Film und als sie mit Sikowitz dafür übt, eröffnet er ihr, dass sie viel zu brav und langweilig ist, um diese Rolle zu füllen. Auch ihre Freunde bestätigen, dass sie ein langweiliger Typ ist.Das kann Tori natürlich nicht auf sich sitzen lassen.Also geht sie mit den anderen in den Gorilla Club. Dort kann man "Spiele" spielen bzw. Mutproben absolvieren. Um zu gewinnen, muss man mutig und risikobereit sein.Zuerst verliert Tori diese"Spiele". Aber allein, dass sie sich traut, lässt ihr Vorsprechen schon besser werden, aber lange noch nicht gut genug.Also probiert sie diese "Spiele" so lange, bis sie sie gewinnt. Als sie dann das richtige Vorsprechen hat, sind die Leute von ihr beeindruckt. Leider hat sie sich bei diesen "Spielen' aber so verletzt, dass sie die Rolle letztendlich doch nicht bekommt.

programme.title: Victorious 3
programme.sub-title: Driving Miss Tori
programme.desc: Da auf Toris und Trinas Schulweg gefilmt wird, dauert die Fahrt dorthin 40 Minuten statt der üblichen fünf. Tori findet die Autofahrt mit Trina schon normalerweise unerträglich, aber 40 Minuten hält sie einfach nicht aus. Daher lässt sie sich nacheinander von Beck, Andre, Robbie und Jade chauffieren, was aber auch nicht besser ist. Dann macht Cat für Tori einen Deal, dass sie einmal mit einem Partybus fahren darf. Natürlich kommen alle mit und diesmal wird die Fahrt zur Schule ein echter Knaller.

programme.title: Max und die Halbritter 4
Max and the Midknights: Time After Time
programme.sub-title: Immer und immer wieder
programme.desc: Im Turm der Zeit hilft Mumblin den Halbrittern, in die Vergangenheit zu reisen, um Torins Bösling aufzuhalten. Zuerst reisen sie zu dem Moment, den Max am meisten bereut: dem Augenblick, in dem sie zuließ, dass der Bösling das Amulett von Königin Nerelia stahl. Leider gelingt es Torin jedes Mal auf absurde und unerwartete Weise, das Amulett dennoch in die Hände zu bekommen, egal wie sehr die Halbritter versuchen, die Vergangenheit zu verändern. Daraufhin ändern die Halbritter ihren Plan und reisen zu dem Zeitpunkt zurück, an dem Torin den Spiegel und ganz Byjovia zerstörte. Diesmal haben sie mehr Erfolg. Max gelingt es, die Vergangenheit zu verändern, und die Halbritter können die Bewohner Byjovias aus der Schattenwelt retten und die Böslinge erfolgreich bekämpfen. Als es so aussieht, als stünde Torins Bösling kurz vor der endgültigen Niederlage, werden die Halbritter jedoch mit unerwarteten Folgen konfrontiert: Ein geheimnisvoller Junge aus der Zukunft namens Nate Wright taucht plötzlich in Byjovia auf.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Der Weg des Schwamms
programme.desc: Aus Langeweile erfinden Patrick und SpongeBob die verschärften Seifenblasen aus scharfer Sauce. Deren Wirkung ist krass, aber amüsant, finden die beiden. Auch Sandy soll in den Genuss der verschärften Blasen kommen, doch die muss sich gerade um ihre verstopften Luftleitungen kümmern. SpongeBobs Idee, die Verstopfung mit scharfen Blasen zu beseitigen, führt leider zur Beseitigung sämtlicher Atemluft in Sandys Baumkuppel und, daraus resultierend, zu ernsthaften Problemen für das Eichhörnchen... // Sandy hat Besuch von ihrem Karatelehrer Fuzzy Acorns, bei dem sie die Prüfung für den noch schwärzeren Gürtel ablegen will. Auch SpongeBob hätte gerne einen Gürtel, doch der schnöselige Karatemeister befindet ihn nach einigen Tests als unwürdig. Sandy wiederum findet, Fuzzy habe vorschnell geurteilt, und nimmt den Meister mit in die Krosse Krabbe, um SpongeBob in voller Aktion zu erleben..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Dunces And Dragons
programme.sub-title: Der edle Ritter
programme.desc: Nach einem Zusammenstoß finden sich SpongeBob und Patrick plötzlich in einer mittelalterlichen Version von Bikini Bottom wieder. Die Einwohner halten die beiden für ritterliche Recken und verpflichten sie prompt, eine Heldentat zu vollbringen: Sie sollen König Krabs' Tochter Perla aus der Gewalt des bösen Zauberers Planktonamor befreien. Als Helfer stellt der König ihnen seinen Hofnarren Thaddäus zur Verfügung, der wegen erwiesener Unwitzigkeit zu nichts anderem zu gebrauchen ist. Notgedrungen bricht das ungleiche Trio zur Festung des Oberschurken auf. Doch der Weg dorthin ist weit und voller Gefahren. Die größte Gefahr geht von dem Schwarzen Ritter aus, einem verdächtig bekannt aussehenden Eichhörnchen. Und auch Planktonamors Feuer speiende Riesenqualle ist ein äußerst fieser Zeitgenosse. Sir SpongeBob und seine Gefährten müssen sich schon besonders ins Zeug legen, um sämtliche Unholde zu besiegen und ihren Auftrag zu erfüllen..

programme.title: iCarly 4
iCarly: iLove You
programme.sub-title: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Warum wird Entertainment für Kinder bloß immer von Erwachsenen gemacht? Das fragt sich die 13-jährige Carly Shay (Miranda Cosgrove) - und beschließt eines Tages, zusammen mit ihren Freunden Samantha "Sam" Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) und Frederick "Freddie" Benson (Nathan Kress) eine eigene Internet-Show auf die Beine zu stellen. In 'iCarly', wie sie die Sendung taufen, fordern sie die Kinder zum Mitmachen auf: Mit Sketchen, seltsamen Rezepten oder bei Carlys Talentsuchen können sie beweisen, was in ihnen steckt. "iCarly" entwickelt sich zu einer Kultsendung, und Carly, Sam und Freddie werden im Netz zu richtigen Berühmtheiten. So müssen sie lernen, ihre alltäglichen Probleme mit ihrem plötzlichen Ruhm unter einen Hut zu bringen - und dabei auch noch jede Woche eine großartige Show abliefern. Wenn Carly gerade nicht vor der Kamera steht, greift sie ihrem älteren Bruder Spencer (Jerry Trainor) unter die Arme, bei dem sie auch wohnt, denn der etwas versponnene Künstler bringt sich durch seine Ungeschicklichkeit öfters mal in Schwierigkeiten.

programme.desc: Warum wird Entertainment für Kinder bloß immer von Erwachsenen gemacht? Das fragt sich die 13-jährige Carly Shay (Miranda Cosgrove) - und beschließt eines Tages, zusammen mit ihren Freunden Samantha "Sam" Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) und Frederick "Freddie" Benson (Nathan Kress) eine eigene Internet-Show auf die Beine zu stellen. In 'iCarly', wie sie die Sendung taufen, fordern sie die Kinder zum Mitmachen auf: Mit Sketchen, seltsamen Rezepten oder bei Carlys Talentsuchen können sie beweisen, was in ihnen steckt. "iCarly" entwickelt sich zu einer Kultsendung, und Carly, Sam und Freddie werden im Netz zu richtigen Berühmtheiten. So müssen sie lernen, ihre alltäglichen Probleme mit ihrem plötzlichen Ruhm unter einen Hut zu bringen - und dabei auch noch jede Woche eine großartige Show abliefern. Wenn Carly gerade nicht vor der Kamera steht, greift sie ihrem älteren Bruder Spencer (Jerry Trainor) unter die Arme, bei dem sie auch wohnt, denn der etwas versponnene Künstler bringt sich durch seine Ungeschicklichkeit öfters mal in Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 11
SpongeBob SquarePants: Doodle Dimension / Moving Bubble Bass
programme.sub-title: In der Kritzelzone / Blubberbernd verzieht sich
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.desc: Historycy Dan Snow i profesor Suzannah Lipscomb śledzą biografię i analizują okoliczności śmierci Anny Boleyn, Marii I Stuart czy Perkina Warbecka, który podawał się za księcia Ryszarda, syna Edwarda IV. Badacze odwiedzają zamki w całej Europie, aby szukać tam cennych wskazówek. Udaje się im uzyskać dostęp do archiwów. Prezentują dowody, które pomagają ustalić nowe fakty na temat tragicznego końca postaci, które zapisały się na kartach historii. Okaże się, czy do ich egzekucji doprowadziły bezwzględne rozgrywki o władzę.

programme.title: Katastrofa w przestworzach
Air Crash Investigation
programme.sub-title: Operacja \"Babylift\"
programme.desc: Rekonstrukcje największych wypadków lotniczych. Każdy z odcinków omawia historię jednego lotu. Twórcy serialu odtwarzają okoliczności, w jakich doszło do tragedii: atmosferę panującą na pokładzie samolotu, decyzje i działania pilotów. Korzystają przy tym z zapisów z czarnych skrzynek. Pokazują też pracę ludzi badających przyczyny owych katastrof i dokonują komputerowej symulacji lotu. Całości dopełniają wywiady z pilotami, ekspertami lotnictwa i świadkami tragicznych wydarzeń. Katastrofy lotnicze wynikają często z ludzkiej opieszałości i braku wyobraźni, pocieszające jest jednak to, że pracownicy przemysłu lotniczego wyciągają wnioski z tragedii i ucząc się na błędach tworzą systemy coraz doskonalsze i coraz mniej zawodne.

W ramach śledztwa należy zabezpieczyć elementy wraku z terenu katastrofy. Przed ekspertami prawdziwe wyzwanie - muszą zrekonstruować całą maszynę, aby ustalić przyczyny tragedii. Odkrycie elementu świadczącego o uderzeniu pioruna stanowi przełom w sprawie. Okazuje się, że wyładowanie uszkodziło układ elektryczny, co w konsekwencji doprowadziło do utraty zasilania.

programme.title: III Rzesza: Droga do upadku
Hitler's Last Stand
programme.sub-title: Szarża na Nijmegen
programme.desc: We wrześniu 1944 roku rozpoczęła się operacja Market Garden w okupowanej Holandii. Celem było opanowanie kluczowych mostów, ominięcie niemieckiej Linii Zygfryda i wkroczenie do Zagłębia Ruhry. Alianccy spadochroniarze trafili w środek krwawych walk z oddziałami SS. Niemcy atakowali strefy zrzutu pociskami przeciwlotniczymi. Amerykanie mieli jedynie minuty na ocalenie szybowców. W pewnym momencie samotny żołnierz ruszył w kierunku dział. Starcie o Nijmegen miało wpływ na to, że wojna przeciągnęła się o kolejny rok.

programme.title: II wojna światowa: Historia przed trybunałem
World War II: History On Trial
programme.desc: Początek roku 1946. W Norymberdze trwa proces przeciwko zbrodniarzom wojennym. Obrona przedstawia własną wersję wydarzeń, wystawiając na próbę ideę sprawiedliwego procesu. Oskarżyciele muszą utrzymać spójną linię argumentacji, gdy Hermann Göring podejmuje grę, która może podważyć autorytet trybunału. W tym samym roku w Tokio rozpoczyna się proces 28 japońskich zbrodniarzy. Tam jednak, w przeciwieństwie do uporządkowanej Norymbergi, na sali sądowej narastają napięcia, spory i polityczne kompromisy.

programme.sub-title: Pechowy pas startowy
programme.desc: 17 lipca 2007 roku. Maszyna odbywająca lot nr 3054 zbliża się do lotniska w Sao Paulo w Brazylii, jednego z najbardziej ruchliwych i niebezpiecznych portów lotniczych na świecie. Piloci zmagają się z dodatkowymi problemami w postaci ulewnego deszczu oraz awarii jednego ze sterów strumieniowych. Kapitan Henrique Stephanini stara się sprowadzić airbusa a-320 na ziemię, jednak maszyna nie chce wytracić prędkości. Przecina pas startowy i uderza w budynek pobliskiej stacji benzynowej. Wszystko natychmiast staje w płomieniach. Nikomu nie udaje się przetrwać. Życie traci 199 osób.

programme.title: Katastrofa w przestworzach
Air Crash Investigation
programme.sub-title: Zabójcze wznoszenie
programme.desc: Kulisy wypadku lotu Tarom 371, do którego doszło 31 marca 1995 roku. Samolot tuż po starcie z lotniska w Bukareszcie zaczął się niebezpiecznie przechylać w lewą stronę. Maszyna spadła na pole w pobliżu miejscowości Balotesti. Zginęły wszystkie osoby obecne na pokładzie - 50 pasażerów i 10 członków załogi. Była to największa katastrofa lotnicza w historii kraju. W mediach pojawiły się spekulacje o wybuchu bomby. Śledczy zwrócili się więc z prośbą o pomoc do agentów FBI. Zapisy z czarnych skrzynek pozwoliły ustalić prawdę. Okazało się, że kapitan nie powiadomił o poważnej awarii silnika.

Hitler's Gold
programme.sub-title: Nazistowski cud gospodarczy
programme.desc: Twórcy czteroodcinkowego serialu analizują ekonomiczne zaplecze III Rzeszy, śledząc tajne konta i ukryte skarby. Odkrywają finansowe wsparcie przemysłowców, które pomogło Hitlerowi zdobyć władzę.

programme.title: Żelazna kurtyna: Życie pod radziecką okupacją
Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.sub-title: Budowa radzieckiego porządku 1948-1953
programme.desc: Opowieść o procesie sowietyzacji, począwszy od 1944 roku do wzniesienia muru berlińskiego. Po II wojnie światowej kraje Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej znalazły się w strefie radzieckiej. Przybliżone zostaną wydarzenia, które doprowadziły do takiego podziału Starego Kontynentu. Widzowie dowiedzą się, jak wpłynęło to na codzienność obywateli tych państw i z jakimi formami oporu się spotkało. Eksperci wyjaśnią, na czym polegały mechanizmy dominacji ZSRR. Nie zabraknie relacji świadków, wywiadów, omówienia prac naukowych i archiwaliów obejmujących filmy propagandowe, domowe nagrania oraz fabuły.

programme.title: Zaginione skarby Biblii: Tajemnice wiary
Lost Treasures of the Bible: Secrets of Faith
programme.sub-title: Tajemnice Arki Przymierza
programme.desc: W nowym świetle zostaną ukazane miasta i cywilizacje znane z biblijnych opowieści. Odkrycia archeologów rewolucjonizują wiedzę o pojedynku Dawida z Goliatem i bitwach pod Armagedonem.

programme.title: Grecja: Miejsce pełne tajemnic
Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.sub-title: Zaginione miasta Aleksandra Wielkiego

programme.title: Miłość w sieci oszustów
Super Scam Me
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller ponownie zagłębia się w przestępczy świat. Ilość przekrętów gwałtownie wzrosła w ostatnich latach. Szacuje się, że w 2024 roku oszuści przejęli ponad bilion dolarów. Dziennikarka analizuje przyczyny tej sytuacji. W ramach śledztwa postara się ustalić, dlaczego tak wiele osób zostaje wprowadzonych w błąd i traci swoje pieniądze.Widzowie poznają mechanizmy, które pozwalają zdobywać zaufanie ofiar, skutecznie nimi manipulować i wykorzystywać do nielegalnych celów ludzkie słabości.

programme.title: Strzegąc granic
Border Patrol
programme.sub-title: Wysyp narkotyków
programme.desc: Serial relacjonuje codzienność oddanych swojej pracy nowozelandzkich celników, pracujących przez całą dobę na granicach państwa. Do ich zadań należy m.in. wyłapywanie transportów narkotyków i innych nielegalnych przedmiotów, czy przechwytywanie obiektów zawierających potencjalnie groźne choroby. Bohaterowie programu zajmują się też monitorowaniem ludzi przybywających do kraju, by zapobiec wkroczeniu na jego teren tych jednostek, których obecność nie jest w nim mile widziana. Widzowie przekonają się z jakiej technologii korzystają celnicy oraz jak wspierają ich wytrenowane zwierzęta.

programme.title: 11 września: Zjednoczeni
9/11 Reunited
programme.desc: Strażak Kevin i ratownik medyczny Al znajdują się pod południową wieżą w chwili jej zawalenia. Drugi z nich bez szwanku wychodzi z katastrofy i przenosi rannego towarzysza w bezpieczne miejsce. W Pentagonie pułkownik Marilyn ewakuuje współpracowników przez okno, a komandos Craig ratuje dzielną żołnierkę, gdy ta traci przytomność w wyniku kontaktu z toksycznym dymem. Po latach ocaleni spotykają swoich wybawców - Al pomaga Kevinowi odtworzyć przebieg zdarzeń, a Craig przypomina Marilyn o jej odwadze.

programme.title: Klucz do przepowiedni
Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.sub-title: Proroctwo wolności, krwawy deszcz i Didyma
programme.desc: Amerykańska abolicjonistka i aktywistka Harriet Tubman traktowała swoje wizje jak wiadomość od Boga. Udało się jej uciec z niewoli 17 września 1849 roku. Pokonała trasę z Maryland do Pensylwanii dzięki sieci tajnych tras zwanej Koleją Podziemną. Później pomagała innym osobom zrzucić kajdany. W 2001 roku na Keralę spadł krwawy deszcz, co obudziło obawy przed apokalipsą. W starożytnej Grecji wyrocznia Apollina przepowiedziała Aleksandrowi Wielkiemu podbój perskiego imperium. Zmieniło to bieg historii.

programme.title: Żelazna kurtyna: Życie pod radziecką okupacją
Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.sub-title: Tłumienie buntów 1953-1961
programme.desc: Opowieść o procesie sowietyzacji, począwszy od 1944 roku do wzniesienia muru berlińskiego. Po II wojnie światowej kraje Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej znalazły się w strefie radzieckiej. Przybliżone zostaną wydarzenia, które doprowadziły do takiego podziału Starego Kontynentu. Widzowie dowiedzą się, jak wpłynęło to na codzienność obywateli tych państw i z jakimi formami oporu się spotkało. Eksperci wyjaśnią, na czym polegały mechanizmy dominacji ZSRR. Nie zabraknie relacji świadków, wywiadów, omówienia prac naukowych i archiwaliów obejmujących filmy propagandowe, domowe nagrania oraz fabuły Po śmierci Stalina możliwe stało się wprowadzenie reform w ZSRR. Protesty wybuchły w Czechosłowacji i Bułgarii, a strajk w NRD zmienił się w narodowy zryw. W nocy z 24 na 25 lutego 1956 roku Nikita Chruszczow wygłosił w czasie XX Zjazdu KPZR tajny referat, w którym potępił zbrodniczy system stworzony przez swojego poprzednika. W październiku doszło do buntu w Polsce, a miesiąc później radzieckie czołgi stłumiły węgierskie powstanie. Pięć lat później wybudowano mur berliński, symbol podziału Europy.

Badacze odwiedzają zamki w całej Europie, aby szukać tam cennych wskazówek. Udaje się im uzyskać dostęp do archiwów. programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: Belgium. American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman. His lifelong drug addiction forced him to concertize and record incessantly. Always popular in Europe, Chet Baker (trumpet, vocals) joined Jacques Pelzer (alto saxophone, flute), Luigi Trussardi (bass), Franco Manzecchi (drums), and RenĂS Urtreger (piano) for a set in Brussels, Belgium, on May 2, 1964. They performed Bye Bye Blackbird, Isn't It Romantic, Airegin, Time After Time and So What. On September 3, 1979, Baker appeared at the Kongsberg Jazz Festival in Norway. He was joined by Wolfgang Lackerschmid (vibraphone), Michel Graillier (piano), and Jean Louis Rassenfosse (bass) for performances of Blue Train, Softly, As In A Morning Sunrise, Five Years Ago, and Love For Sale.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: North Sea Jazz, The Hague, The Netherlands. The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976. This broadcast from the North Sea Jazz Archives presents the great Wayne Shorter Quartet. Shorterâs maxim is to reinvent his music during each concert. He means to give his music a radical originality.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: . Pianist Kenny Barronâs June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraineâs Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: The Blue Necklace
programme.desc: Singer Concertzaal, Laren. Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman & Peter King
programme.desc: Jazz en Baie, Mont-Saint-Michel, France. Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Todayâs broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musiciansâ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer StĂSphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show. Although the two saxophonists have an average age of 70, these jazz titans will convince you youâre watching young musicians on stage â albeit with 70 years of experience.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: Various locations. âGod Bless The Childâ, âFoolinâ Myselfâ, and âI Loves You, Porgyâ: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. âLady Dayâ, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazzâs all-time greats.

programme.title: Terrasson & Belmondo: Ă Nous Garo
programme.desc: Jazz en Baie, Mont-Saint-Michel, France. Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Todayâs broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter StĂSphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson franĂ§aise. The Franco-American pianist Terrasson delights in travelling the world, collaboration with others and leading his own trio, quartet, or quintet. With his long-time friend, StĂSphane Belmondo, Terrasson has produced wonderful CDs and beautiful concerts. One then finds the trumpeter on the pianistâs album âGouacheâ; on another, the pianist guests on Belmondoâs âEver Afterâ. At the Jazz en Baie festival, the duo plays its amazing piano and trumpet music. Highly recommended.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: The Mars Club, Paris, France. This vintage program, âJazz Marmaladeâ, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter âBigâ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907â1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-ĂlysĂSes, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs âSalut Les Copinesâ. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926â2018) performs a jaunty take on âC-Jam Bluesâ. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging âApril in Parisâ. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baobap Orchestra
programme.desc: St. Louis Jazz Festval, Senegal. These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Melkweg, Amsterdam, The Netherlands. New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensembleâs high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix. NCC includes saxophonist Benjamin Herman, guitarist Rory Ronde, drummer Joost Kroon, percussionists Frank van Dok and Jos de Haas, pianist Willem Friede, bassist Leslie Lopez, and trumpeter David Rockefeller.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Sweden. Anita OâDayâŻboasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the âjazz singer supremeâ in impeccable form. OâDayâs horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites âTea For Twoâ and âSweet Georgia Brownâ (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz musicâs true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson & Kenny G
programme.desc: North Sea Jazz Festival, The Hague, The Netherlands. The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976. This broadcast from the North Sea Jazz Archives presents a compilation with music of George Benson & Kenny G.

programme.title: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Burghausen, AltĂśtting, Germany. Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Hypnotic Brass Ensemble, which consists of eight sons of jazz trumpeter and one-time Sun Ra Arkestra member Phil Cohran. He trained his children to play their horns and instilled in them a profound sense of the deeply spiritual roots of the music. The Hypnotic Brass Ensemble's music ranges from hypnotizing grooves to jazzy funk.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: . An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Estival Jazz, Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs âIt Donât Mean A Thingâ. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song âAinât Nobodyâs Businessâ ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: Kurhaus Scheveningen, The Hague, Netherlands. The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen. Accompanied by his big band, which included talents such as saxophonist Arnett Cobb, the "King of Vibes" gave an invigorating performance with both mallets and voice.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins Ă Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz Ă Vienne Festival, France. Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album âTha Funk Capitol of the Worldâ. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz Ă Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival, Den Haag, The Netherlands. The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festivalâs staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: PatĂĄx: A Night to Remember 2/2
programme.desc: Teatro CalderĂłn, Madrid, Spain. PatĂĄx was heavily influenced by seminal fusion bands like Weather Report and Return to Forever. Donât mistake this Spanish powerhouse for a carbon copy of either, however, as PatĂĄx presents an accomplished mix of styles, including soul, jazz, funk and hip-hop. The group is led by the passionate Spanish-American percussionist Jorge Perez, who draws his musical influence from both sides of the Atlantic. The tight interplay between Perez and his bandmates as well as the audienceâs enthusiasm at Teatro CalderĂłn in Madrid make it a night to remember. This is the second of two parts.

Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
